verdict.rationale: Docs confirm official libraries/clients exist for popular languages ('wide range of official libraries and developer tools'), but the evidence pack gives no specifics on which languages (JS, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go) are covered or how currency/versioning is maintained across them. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported languages/frameworks, release-cadence/version-parity evidence, and independent confirmation of SDK quality or community satisfaction with specific clients.
